# `Q-24-10` — Images Converted

> EMF or WMF images were converted to SVG so browsers can display them.

## What this means

The document embedded EMF or WMF images. They were converted to SVG in the browser and stored as PNG; the count says how many.

## Why this happens

- The document came from an older Word version, or the images were pasted from a drawing application.

## How to fix

Nothing needs fixing. Check the converted images look right.
